title: Set of Beautiful Designer Kitchen Tools
text:
Set of Beautiful Designer Kitchen Tools. This KITCHENAID 7-PIECE KITCHEN TOOL SET (KT455MLER; Red) has all the basic tools (slotted turner, basting spoon, slotted spoon, short turner, ladle, silicone tipped tongs, manual can opener), but does NOT include a rack to hang them on. My set arrived in frustration-free packaging (a plain brown corrugated cardboard box, NOT a retail box); and this is something to consider if you’re giving this set as a gift.

These beautiful designer tools are made of heavy-gauge stainless steel, and the red handles will perfectly match your red Kitchenaid stand mixer and/or your other red Kitchenaid appliances. They are functional tools (with hanging loops), but they seem more at home hanging decoratively on the walls of your Kitchenaid kitchen, than being held in your hands as you cook everyday meals.

As working tools, I prefer the ones with nonstick nylon or silicone turners, spoons, etc. Among these types of tools, my favorite brands are Sabatier (e.g., [[ASIN:B01FM0JEHW Sabatier slotted turner]]), and OXO (e.g., [[ASIN:B003L0OOVW OXO nylon ladle]]).

features: 7-PIECE SET: This 7-piece KitchenAid set includes: slotted turner, basting spoon, slotted spoon, short turner, ladle, can opener and a pair of silicone tipped tongs.
STAINLESS STEEL TOOL SET: This kitchen tool set is crafted of 18/8 stainless steel with red-accented handles.
EASY TO STORE: All tools, with the exception of the can opener, have a hanging loop at the end for easy and convenient storage. KitchenAid's design allows for multiple storage options.
GIFTABLE: Sleek European inspired design elements make for an exceptional gift for holidays, weddings, or special occasions.
DISHWASHER SAFE TOOL SET: All tools are dishwasher safe. The can opener should be hand washed and towel dried. This tool set comes with a 1-year hassle free replacement and Lifetime Limited Warranty.
description: Kitchenaid brings its legendary quality and performance to this versatile stainless-steel set. All tools except the can opener have a hanging loop for convenient storage. All tools are dishwasher safe, Can opener which should be hand washed; one year hassle-free replacement and lifetime limited .
